short_description: Procedural geomorphology derived from accepted G7 semantic fields and G3/G5/G6 surface, feature and hydrology truth.
purpose: Add deterministic valley, river-channel, bank, floodplain and erosion/deposition shaping without taking ownership of persistent Matter mutations, world identity, authority, persistence or material ontology.
expected_outcome: A replaceable, provenance-friendly geomorphology layer that produces stable surface deformation independent from SurfaceCellKey, LOD, camera and representation and can later feed geology/volume/detail stages.
progress_note: G8.2 River Channel Incision is ACCEPTED after exact-Windows full acceptance on tested head 491fe10877c70c362c14ab595a8a0204165a880a with G8.1 parent PASS, river-channel PASS, valley+river composition PASS, ownership PASS, world/core regression through NX4 PASS, RL3 representation-aware streaming 175 assertions, RL3 process streaming 37 assertions, main_scene_cli_all 6 PASS / 0 FAIL, STOPPED lifecycle and CLEAN working tree. G8.3 is implemented as a replaceable banks/floodplain layer over the exact accepted G8.2 result. It uses the same surface-height, valley-influence, river-distance and river-width semantic bundle. Distances are normalized by channel half-width. The bank shoulder rises smoothly from normalized 1.0 to a peak at 1.5 and returns to zero at 2.0; the floodplain enters smoothly from 2.0 to 2.5, remains full through 4.5 and fades to zero by 6.0. Bank amplitude is +bank_max_delta_m * bank_weight * valley_influence; floodplain amplitude is -floodplain_max_delta_m * floodplain_weight * valley_influence. G8.3 preserves exact G8.2 valley and river components and keeps erosion/deposition zero. geo/fluid-surface-distance-m is deliberately not reinterpreted as signed water elevation. No SurfaceCellKey, LOD, Matter, authority, persistence, material or network ownership is introduced. Focused and full Windows validation are pending.
